changelog:
- Initial release of the Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) style note generator.
- Generates 3:4 vertical high-res PNG images (1080×1440 @2x) for single or multi-image knowledge cards and infographic notes.
- Produces publish-ready Xiaohongshu captions with title options, body, and hashtags.
- Built-in 7 randomizable visual themes; users can select or add styles.
- Enforces Xiaohongshu best practices: personal blogger tone, punchy covers, one knowledge point per page, and clear call-to-action.
- Not intended for use with PPT decks, courseware, or instructor slides.
summary: Generate Xiaohongshu-style 3:4 vertical image notes with concise knowledge points, eye-catching covers, and ready-to-post captions including titles and hasht...
